complete_examples.text: For example, the first two statistical moments (e.g. mean, variance, etc.) can be directly analyzed and obtained via the coefficients of the polynomial model.

Fortunately, the widespread application of meta models such as the polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) in the field of uncertainty provides new ideas for estimating the statistical moments of response functions.
